title: One Point of Daylight: The Horse is Hea Survives Dawgs 122.7 to 121.7 While Brock Bowers Watches From the Bench
dek: The commissioner escapes by a single point, Randy actually makes a trade, and three teams sit at 3-0 while three more sit at 0-3 after the league's most nerve-wracking week yet.
body: Week 3's best game came down to the width of a single point. Sonny's The Horse is Hea beat Mekhi's Dawgs 122.7 to 121.7, the kind of finish that makes a manager refresh the app until the battery begs for mercy. The Horse is Hea entered as a 64% favorite and nearly gave all of it back. Jaxon Smith-Njigba carried the load again with 30.36 points on a 17.19 projection, following last week's 38-point outburst, and the commish is now 3-0 with his title odds more than doubling, from 10% to 21%.

For Mekhi, this one is going to sting for a while. Brock Bowers scored 22.6 points on Dawgs' bench against an 11.15 projection, in a game decided by one point. Justin Jefferson didn't help, posting 4.2 on a 14.79 projection. The frustrating part is that Kai actually nailed the waiver wire: he grabbed Tyler Shough for Jameson Williams, and Shough delivered 23.8 points in his Dawgs debut. Dawgs are 0-3, but their 320.8 points are more than 1-1... sorry, 1-2 Ghostu-Spider SZN's 299, which is the kind of stat that should come with a sympathy card.

Ramon's No Banner only HULK kept rolling, beating Kaushal's Habibsters 134.46 to 100.74 as a heavy favorite. The HULK leads the league with 444.2 points, 72.6 more than anyone else, and Matthew Stafford once again scored big from the bench with 20.9. Oddly, Ramon's title odds slipped from 54% to 52% despite the win, mostly because Sonny's surge took a bite out of the pie. Kaushal got 23.9 from Drake London on a 12.52 projection, but Habibsters fell to 0-3 anyway. Habib kept working, adding Sam LaPorta for Wan'Dale Robinson, swapping in the 49ers D/ST for the Buccaneers D/ST, and cutting kicker Jake Bates to bring back Deebo Samuel Sr.

Alan's Team Pillbert handled Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV 117.88 to 100.98, a 16.9-point win as a 77% favorite. Jahmyr Gibbs posted the week's best line with 37.9 points, and Brock Purdy added 31.28, a one-two punch that covered for De'Von Achane's 1.7 on a 17.27 projection. Harold Fannin Jr. also scored 20.6 on Philly's bench, so this could have been a rout. Strangely, Team Pillbert won and still saw title odds dip from 13% to 9%. Jordan scored 100.98, his best output of the season, but Counting or not Counting GV is 0-3 with a league-low 259 points; JMoney added the Patriots D/ST and Tank Bigsby and dropped the Eagles D/ST looking for answers.

The lowest-scoring winner of the week was Randy. The fumblers beat Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN 91.64 to 86.64, surviving a dud from Jonathan Taylor, who scored 8.2 on a 19.1 projection. Zoe had the week's second-best performance in Bijan Robinson, who blew up for 34.3 against a 17.31 projection, and the rookie pushed a 32% underdog to within five points. She also reshaped her roster aggressively, adding Josh Downs for Brian Thomas Jr., Blake Corum for Jonathon Brooks, and kicker Trey Smack for Cairo Santos. Randy is 3-0, though his title odds slid from 21% to 16%.

Now for the headline nobody had on their bingo card: Randy made a trade. The fumblers sent Javonte Williams to Team Pillbert for Stefon Diggs, which means the league's most reluctant dealer not only picked up the phone but did business with Alan. The other deal had the commissioner trading with the league leader, as Sonny took Chuba Hubbard and sent Rashee Rice to Ramon. Conspiracy theorists will note that the guy who runs the league just helped arm the juggernaut he has to chase, which is either generous sportsmanship or a very strange abuse of power.

The standings are cleanly split. No Banner only HULK, The Horse is Hea, and The fumblers are all 3-0, with title odds of 52%, 21%, and 16%, and Team Pillbert sits fourth at 2-1 with 76% playoff odds. Below that, it's a cliff: Ghostu-Spider SZN is 1-2 with 10% playoff odds, while Dawgs, Habibsters, and Counting or not Counting GV are all 0-3. Dawgs and Habibsters both have more points than Zoe's team, so there's evidence that some of that winless pain is bad luck rather than bad rosters.

Week 4 opens with the marquee game: Alan's Team Pillbert against Ramon's No Banner only HULK, two guys the league loves to root against facing each other, so everyone else gets to root against somebody no matter what. Zoe draws the 3-0 commissioner with a chance to bring Sonny back to earth. Randy's The fumblers face Kaushal's Habibsters, who desperately need a first win. And Dawgs host Counting or not Counting GV in a battle of 0-3 teams where somebody finally gets off the schneid.

social.author: Horse is Hea Fan Club
social.text: 122.7 to 121.7. One point. We aged a decade on Monday night. 3-0 and we'll take it any way it comes.

social.author: Dawg Pound Diehard
social.text: Brock Bowers: 22.6 on the bench. Final margin: 1 point. I need to lie down. Shough was great though. 23.8 off waivers. Pain and pride in one box score.

social.author: Buckaroo Insider
social.text: Sources confirm Randy has made a trade. Repeat: Randy has made a trade. Stefon Diggs is a fumbler. Javonte Williams is a Pillbert. Check on your loved ones.

social.author: The Fantasy Actuary
social.text: Team Pillbert wins by 16.9 and drops from 13% to 9% title odds. No Banner only HULK wins by 33.72 and drops from 54% to 52%. Winning is apparently not enough anymore.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider Superfan
social.text: Bijan 34.3. Lost by 5. Downs, Corum, and Smack are in. The rookie is reloading. Commish, you're next.

social.author: Gibbs Truther
social.text: Gibbs 37.9, Purdy 31.28, Achane 1.7. Team Pillbert's backfield went from a feast to a famine in one game and still cleared 117.

social.author: HULK Nation
social.text: 3-0. 444.2 points. Stafford on the bench with 20.9 again. Rashee Rice joins the party. Next up: Team Pillbert. Bring snacks.

social.author: Midwest Waiver Watch
social.text: Kaushal dropped a kicker to add Deebo and picked up LaPorta for Wan'Dale. 0-3 Habibsters are fighting back. The fumblers are up next.

social.author: 0-3 Support Group
social.text: Week 4 Dawgs vs Counting or not Counting GV. One of you leaves with a win. The other leaves with us. We have chairs.

bios.1: Sonny is 3-0 after a 1-point escape against Dawgs, and his title odds jumped from 10% to 21%, second-best in the league. Jaxon Smith-Njigba has posted 30-plus points in back-to-back weeks. He added Chuba Hubbard in a trade with Ramon and gets Zoe in Week 4.
bios.2: Randy is 3-0 despite a 91.64-point week and an 8.2 from Jonathan Taylor, a reminder that ugly wins still count. He shocked the league by trading Javonte Williams for Stefon Diggs. Title odds dipped to 16%, but the playoff odds sit at 92%.
bios.3: Jordan is 0-3 with a league-low 259 points, though his 100.98 against Team Pillbert was his best showing yet. He added Tank Bigsby and swapped the Eagles D/ST for the Patriots D/ST. With 1% playoff odds, a Week 4 matchup with fellow 0-3 Dawgs is the best chance yet for a first win.
bios.4: Alan is 2-1 behind Jahmyr Gibbs' 37.9 and Brock Purdy's 31.28, and Team Pillbert's playoff odds are 76%. Philly keeps working the roster, adding Bryce Young, Denzel Boston, and Javonte Williams. A meeting with No Banner only HULK next week will show how real this run is.
bios.5: Mekhi is 0-3 but has scored 320.8 points, and he lost this week by a single point with Brock Bowers' 22.6 sitting on the bench. Waiver pickup Tyler Shough looked like an instant hit with 23.8. Next up is a winless matchup with Counting or not Counting GV, where one of these teams finally breaks through.
bios.6: Kaushal is 0-3 and the schedule has not been kind, with a loss to No Banner only HULK this week despite Drake London's 23.9. The two-time champ added Sam LaPorta, Deebo Samuel Sr., and the 49ers D/ST to keep fighting. At 12% playoff odds, a Week 4 date with 3-0 The fumblers is a must-win.
bios.7: Ramon's juggernaut is 3-0 with a league-best 444.2 points and 100% playoff odds, and it keeps winning with real points on the bench. The commish just traded him Rashee Rice, which feels like handing a bulldozer extra fuel. A Week 4 showdown with Team Pillbert is the next test.
bios.8: Zoe is 1-2 after a five-point loss to The fumblers that came even with Bijan Robinson's 34.3. The rookie overhauled her roster with Josh Downs, Blake Corum, and Trey Smack. At 10% playoff odds, a win over the 3-0 commish would change everything.
